scope: Polish sites to buy bikes from, ranked for buying quality and separately assessed for machine-fetchability as sources for the docs/bikes backfill pipeline.
probe_method: curl -sL with a full desktop UA (Mozilla/5.0 Windows NT 10.0 Win64 x64 Chrome/120). Recorded: home HTTP status, /products.json?limit=1 status, /sitemap.xml status, home body size, count of application/ld+json blocks on the HOME page, platform fingerprint. ld_json_blocks_home is a home-page count, NOT a promise about product pages.
key_findings: Every listed site answers a real UA; several return nothing or 403 without one. decathlon.pl 403s all HTML even with a UA.
Shopify products.json is effectively dead in Poland: 1 of 16 probed sites (rowerowy.com). The pipeline's shopify_index.py strategy does not carry over.
The transferable route is sitemap -> product page -> schema.org JSON-LD. Confirmed working end-to-end only on rowertour.com.
Product-level JSON-LD was verified on a real product detail page for rowertour.com only. Other sites were confirmed at home/category level.

sites.name: CentrumRowerowe.pl
sites.why: Market leader. Owned by listed Dadelo S.A., own warehouse, ~3000 m2 flagship near Warsaw Okecie plus salons in Wroclaw, Gdansk, Poznan, Krakow, Rzeszow, Zabrze, Bydgoszcz. Same prices online and in store.
sites.notes: Returned an empty body without a UA and 167 KB with one. No /sitemap.xml.

sites.name: Sprint-Rowery.pl
sites.why: Widest bike selection claim in PL. Large showrooms in Bialystok and Warszawa, 0% installments, bikes shipped assembled. Strongest content and customer-education arm.

sites.name: RowerTour.com
sites.why: Bydgoszcz, founded 2012 by two ex-racers, now one of the largest PL online bike shops.
sites.notes: Best structured data of the whole set. Split sitemap index including sitemap_shop_products_*.xml. Product detail pages carry a full schema.org Product node - verified live: name, brand, priceCurrency PLN, price, availability, image[]. Best candidate for a direct (non-LLM) offer finder.

sites.name: SklepRowerowy.PL
sites.why: Full service: bikes, parts, apparel, service, bikefitting.

sites.name: BikeSalon.pl
sites.why: Strong Warsaw retailer (ul. Ostrobramska), rated 4.44 stars over 186 reviews.
sites.notes: Most bot-hostile of the ten - sitemap 403.

sites.name: Green Bike
sites.why: Retailer AND manufacturer (Goetze.bike) - one of the biggest PL bike producers and employers in the sector.
sites.notes: Thin 54 KB home and zero JSON-LD.

sites.name: Bikestacja.pl
sites.why: Broad city / road / MTB range. Has an English storefront at /en/.

sites.name: Rowerowy.com
sites.why: Gravity specialist - dirt, pumptrack, enduro, all-mountain, DH. 20+ years of mail order.
sites.notes: The ONLY Shopify in the set. pipeline/shopify_index.py works against it as-is - add to SITES.

sites.name: Kross
sites.why: Largest PL brand's own store. First-party spec truth. Pair with romet.pl, unibike.pl, legrand.pl.
sites.notes: Sibling manufacturer romet.pl serves a 9101-byte shell - matches WORKFLOW.md round 5's note that romet.pl (Magento PWA) resisted discovery.

sites.name: Decathlon.pl
sites.why: Biggest sports retailer in PL by footprint. Own brands Rockrider (MTB), Triban (road), Elops (city), Btwin, Van Rysel (performance) - the only entry that is both manufacturer and sole seller. Cheapest credible entry-level bikes in the country, ~80 stores for pickup and service.
sites.notes: 403 on EVERY HTML URL even with a full desktop UA - home, /c/rowery and /browse/... all refused. Only the XML sitemaps answer. Crucially the sitemap index has NO product sitemap: only brands, category-product-listing, filtered-pages, content-pages, services-repair, sports-activities. Category URLs like /sporty/rowery/rowery-xc are enumerable but themselves 403. Worst technically, roughly 2nd-3rd on the buying axis - the two orderings diverge sharply here.
sites.backend_note: Vindicates app/bike_offer_decathlon_finder.py going through web_search rather than fetching, and returning photos: []. Against a site that 403s all HTML and publishes no product sitemap that is the only thing that works - not a shortcut to upgrade later.

runners_up.name: ArenaRowery.pl
runners_up.why: Kross, Scott, Cube, Kellys, Unibike, Romet, Kands, Le Grand, Maxim, e-bikes.

runners_up.name: Interbike.pl
runners_up.why: Tomar Sport's online arm, ships fully assembled.

runners_up.name: Sportano.pl
runners_up.why: Generalist sports retailer with a real bike range. Most machine-friendly of the generalists.

recommended_next_steps: Add rowerowy.com to SITES in pipeline/shopify_index.py - it is Shopify and needs no new code.

rowertour.com and sportano.pl are the two best candidates for a fifth backend offer finder: both expose price, currency and availability as structured data, so they need no LLM parsing unlike the existing web_search finders.
Send a real desktop UA on every request to these hosts - several return empty or 403 without one.
